services_shape: set services with a chosen barber, booked in 15-minute steps; quick services fill the short gaps they fit
questions_before_times: the service, and which barber (or the first free)
anyone else in the group, and how many (a group of 3 or more at the shop asks Sam first)
for a kids cut: the child's age
for a house call or event: the kind of place, and the town or ZIP
for a wedding party: how many people, what each wants, the date and the start time
safety_stop: a dye reaction happening now: face, lips or throat swelling, trouble breathing
a deep cut that won't stop bleeding
first_steps: Skin test for beard color (a small test for a reaction to hair dye)
license: always: barbering is licensed where the state's rules require it
staff_skills: cuts, fades, beard work, razor shaves, kids cuts, beard color, house calls and events; only barbers who do color are offered for beard color
messages_never: dye-reaction, skin-test and skin or scalp answers never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the customer's record; the customer never hears why a barber is out
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
